cues.en: Welcome to this section on fine tuning LA.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到 LLM 微調這一節。

cues.en: In the beginning of the previous section, I briefly discussed what it means to fine tune models and how that differs from pre-training.
cues.zh: 上一節開頭，簡單談過微調的意思，以及與預訓練的差別。

cues.en: So in this video, I will reiterate that distinction and point out a few of the challenges of fine tuning that you will discover in this section.
cues.zh: 這裡再重述，並指出這一節將發現的幾個挑戰。

cues.en: This is the table summary that you saw in the beginning of the previous section.
cues.zh: 這是上一節開頭看過的摘要表。

cues.en: And here I will just briefly remind you of the ideas of fine tuning models.
cues.zh: 簡短提醒微調的概念。

cues.en: When you fine tune an LA, you don't start from an initialized random weights.
cues.zh: 微調 LLM，不從隨機初始化權重開始。

cues.en: Instead, you download weights that other organizations have already spent months training on a gigantic corpus of text.
cues.zh: 而是下載其他組織已花數月、用龐大文字語料訓練的權重。

cues.en: So that foundational model is already able to understand and produce grammatically and syntactically sensible text.
cues.zh: 基礎模型已能理解、產生文法與句法合理的文字。

cues.en: What you would then do in fine tuning is tweak and adapt the model to some specific task.
cues.zh: 微調則進一步調整、適應特定任務。

cues.en: And what exactly is involved in fine tuning, practically speaking?
cues.zh: 實務上，具體需要什麼？

cues.en: Well, you start by finding a base model that is suitable for your application.
cues.zh: 先找適合應用的基礎模型。

cues.en: So there isn't just GPT two from OpenAI.
cues.zh: 不只有 OpenAI 的 GPT-2。

cues.en: There are hundreds of base models that different groups or companies have produced and made available.
cues.zh: 不同團隊、公司已提供幾百種基礎模型。

cues.en: Some of them are smaller, some of them are larger.
cues.zh: 有小、有大。

cues.en: In this section and in the next section, I will show you several of these models that we can download.
cues.zh: 這一節與下一節，會展示幾種可以下載的模型。

cues.en: Next you get a data set.
cues.zh: 接著取得資料集。

cues.en: So to make this a little bit more concrete, let's say for example, that you are working for a nonprofit
cues.zh: 具體一點，假設你在非營利

cues.en: organization focused on improving financial literacy in developing countries.
cues.zh: 組織工作，專注提升開發中國家的金融素養。

cues.en: You could take a pre-trained GPT and gather lots of texts about advice for financial literacy that is
cues.zh: 可以取預訓練 GPT，收集大量金融素養建議文字，

cues.en: custom tailored for people in developing countries.
cues.zh: 特別針對開發中國家的民眾。

cues.en: Maybe it's publicly available text online, or maybe you reach out to experts in this domain and ask
cues.zh: 也許是網路公開文字，也可以找領域專家，

cues.en: them to write specific pieces of advice that you can use for training sets.
cues.zh: 請他們撰寫特定建議，作為訓練集。

cues.en: In other words, the data set that you use for fine tuning is curated and domain specific.
cues.zh: 也就是，微調資料經過挑選，且針對特定領域。

cues.en: Now, that also means that you have a lot less data, which means that instead of the training requiring
cues.zh: 這也代表資料少得多，所以不必

cues.en: months on gigantic clusters of ultra expensive GPUs, you can fine tune a pre-trained model maybe in a couple of days, maybe a couple of weeks.
cues.zh: 在超昂貴、大型 GPU 叢集訓練幾個月，可能幾天、幾週就能微調。

cues.en: If it's a really big model and you have a lot of data.
cues.zh: 如果模型很大、資料很多。

cues.en: But it could also even be just a few hours.
cues.zh: 也可能只需要幾小時。

cues.en: The point is that once you have the base model and you have a data set, then you keep training the model using gradient descent.
cues.zh: 重點是，有基礎模型與資料集後，就繼續用梯度下降訓練。

cues.en: Exactly the same way that I showed you how to train models from scratch in the previous section.
cues.zh: 和上一節從零訓練的方式完全相同。

cues.en: The math is the same, the code is the same.
cues.zh: 數學、程式相同。

cues.en: There are a few differences that you'll see in this section.
cues.zh: 也有幾個差異，這一節會看到。

cues.en: For example, you want to use smaller learning rates for fine tuning and you often apply some additional adjustments like freezing some of the layers.
cues.zh: 例如微調要較小學習率，也常加其他調整，例如凍結部分層。

cues.en: Basically, you do not want to overwrite or train out any of the basic syntax or world knowledge that
cues.zh: 基本上，不想覆寫、訓練掉模型在預訓練

cues.en: the model has already learned during pre-training, and so fine tuning should be a little bit more subtle and more targeted.
cues.zh: 已學到的基本句法、世界知識，所以微調應更細微、目標更明確。

cues.en: As you'll learn in this section, there are many, many ways to adjust the training procedure, and
cues.zh: 這一節會學很多調整程序的方法，

cues.en: it's not always clear which parameters to pick, which protocols to use, and what's going to be successful.
cues.zh: 不一定清楚該選哪些參數、流程，怎樣才成功。

cues.en: So in practice, fine tuning involves a lot of testing, experimenting, exploring, evaluating, and doing it all over again.
cues.zh: 所以實務上需要很多測試、實驗、探索、評估，再全部重來。

cues.en: So yeah, fine tuning means taking a model that someone else has spent a lot of time and effort and resources to develop, and then you improve it for your own specific needs.
cues.zh: 微調就是取得別人花很多時間、心力、資源開發的模型，再依特定需求改善。

cues.en: One of the points that I will stress in this section is that fine tuning is both very easy and very hard.
cues.zh: 會強調的一點是，它同時非常簡單、非常困難。

cues.en: It's very easy to implement, but it's hard to know what are the optimal choices to make to get the best results.
cues.zh: 實作容易，但很難知道哪些選擇最佳，才能取得最好結果。
